# Third-Party Vendor Assets

This directory contains vendored client-side runtime libraries to ensure 100% offline, loopback-isolated operation with zero external CDN dependencies.

## 1. Tailwind CSS (Play CDN Standalone)
- **Version:** 3.4.17
- **File:** `tailwindcss.js`
- **Upstream:** https://cdn.tailwindcss.com
- **License:** MIT License (Copyright (c) Tailwind Labs, Inc.)
- **Usage:** Injected via `<script src="/vendor/tailwindcss.js"></script>`

## 2. Lucide Icons (Vanilla UMD Bundle)
- **Version:** 1.41.0
- **File:** `lucide.min.js`
- **Upstream:** https://unpkg.com/lucide
- **License:** ISC License (Copyright (c) Lucide Contributors)
- **Usage:** Injected via `<script src="/vendor/lucide.min.js"></script>`
